theme: An open day, with the pressure sitting off-calendar.
greeting: The calendar's nearly empty today, Dan — one midday call and the rest is yours. What actually needs you is off-calendar: a governance call to lock in and a stack of Croatia bookings that have to close before you sail.

needsAttention.title: Pick a time with Conor Kehoe
needsAttention.detail: Conor's assistant Kate wrote this morning with slots for the PRI governance chat — Wed Sep 2, 10:00–11:30 EDT, or Thu Sep 3 around 09:30 EDT. She's waiting on you to choose one.

needsAttention.title: Confirm checked bags on the Croatia ticket
needsAttention.detail: Your issued ticket shows zero checked bags on both Eurowings Discover legs; confirm the allowance on the operating carrier's site and buy bags now, before counter fees. In Todoist, p1 and overdue since Aug 25.

needsAttention.title: Book the last Croatia and St Pete nights
needsAttention.detail: Cavtat for Sat Sep 19 after the charter, plus the St Pete landing gap Sep 20–21 — both need locking before you fly out Sep 8, when boat connectivity disappears. In Todoist, p1 and several days overdue.

flagged.title: Nautilus sailing balance due
flagged.detail: QuickBooks invoice 2170 shows a $6,475 balance for the course, and Amy at Nautilus flagged the final payment on Aug 26.

flagged.title: Liberty Mutual home renewal
flagged.detail: Your home policy renewal notice landed Aug 26 — worth a look before it auto-renews.

inbox.noise: The rest is receipts and reminders — Airbnb and Enterprise confirmations, a neighborhood newsletter.

resolved.title: Tokyo board contacts wrote back
resolved.detail: Furuta-san and Sakai's office both replied Aug 26, noting your possible Tokyo visit the week of Sep 30 — nothing owed for now.

resolved.title: Sailing textbooks shipped
resolved.detail: Nautilus confirmed your course materials are on the way to Dubrovnik; tracking arrived Aug 25.

recipe.title: Chambéry Trout
recipe.why: High summer wants a light hand — a delicate trout, gently poached, lets the season's fresh herbs and vermouth do the talking.

tasks.title: Buy EU plug adapters + a US power strip

acts.line: The morning stayed open — nothing on the calendar before noon.
A single call with Martin Steindl of Valoris Catalysts.
The afternoon is clear; the Croatia bookings are what's waiting.
